title: Cross-arch CLI next binaries ladder
goal: Define and implement the next cross-ISA machinen move continuation ladder for cat, dd, wc -l, seq, and fixed-string grep, while refusing every unmodeled shortcut or resource shape.
problemStatement: machinen move needs the next small CLI binaries to continue across ISAs without pretending that restart, reexec, or replay is live-state continuation.
solutionStatement: Deliver proof-backed semantic continuation envelopes for cat, dd, wc -l, seq, and fixed-string grep with fail-closed refusals for unsafe variants.
technicalStatement: Model each binary as captured architecture-neutral semantic state, plan a target-native continuation step from that state, route only proven envelopes, and test every shortcut refusal.
